validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real. Multiple MEED articles (cat-pounces-on-pipelines, aramco-tenders-major-pipeline-jobs, hawiyah-pipeline-programme-progresses, juaymah-fractionation-plant-goes-first) describe an Aramco EPC job to build 'a 38-inch-diameter, 56-kilometre-long ethane line looped with two existing pipelines and aimed at transporting 820 million cubic feet a day of gas to Jubail industrial city' between the Juaymah gas plant and Jubail. So endpoints (Al Juaymah gas plant -> Al Jubail), 56 km length, and 820 MMcf/d capacity all corroborate the GEM values. CLASSIFICATION CONCERN: the verified sources unambiguously call this an ETHANE line, part of the Juaymah fractionation / Hawiyah NGL recovery program (which produces ~310,000 bbl/d of ethane + NGL and ships product to Jubail and NGL to Ju'aymah). GEM records Fuel=Gas with no type qualifier; ethane is gaseous so 'Gas' is defensible, but this is an NGL-program product/feeder line, NOT a gas transmission trunk, and that nuance is lost in the current record. SPEC CAVEAT: GEM Diameter='38,30,40 in' but only 38 in is sourced; 30 and 40 are unsourced and most likely conflate the two PRE-EXISTING pipelines the new 38-in line is looped alongside (i.e. they are not part of this ProjectID's new pipe). INDEPENDENCE CAVEAT: every detailed corroborating source traces to a single outlet (MEED); DMS Projects confirms the Juaymah NGL facilities expansion context but not the pipe specs, and PetroConsultancy/petrotrade is paywalled/403. The two refs actually on the gem.wiki page (OPEC ASB 2012 p.75 and ASB 2013 p.79) do NOT verify (403 / token absent), so they should not be relied on. DUPLICATE check: compared against the 65-row Saudi gas roster; no other ProjectID describes a Juaymah->Jubail ethane line at 56 km / 38 in / 820 MMcf/d, so not a duplicate. ATTRIBUTION: Owner/Operator Saudi Aramco and FuelSource 'Al Juaima'h' (Juaymah gas plant) are consistent with sources.
